description:
So, WHAT IS INVESTRIX? - InvesTriX is a hypothetical FinTech platform. Which is planned to be created by 2025.

And, FOR WHOM IS THIS PLATFORM? - InvesTriX is an investing app for GenZ! For the youth, by the youth! Empowering the future by empowering today's young generation is our mission.

Then, IS THIS A NON-PROFIT? ANY SPECIAL BUSINESS MODEL OR SOMETHING UNIQUE TO GAIN PROFIT? - InvesTriX will have no central authority, as the whole framework will be decentralized and use Blockchain tech for transaction and record keeping. That's our foundation - our transparency. But yes, we are no non-profit.

We have innovated a new model of DIVERSIFICATION. Money/Equity/Asset diversification is a major league skill the big name companies and investors keep to themselves.

But InvesTriX is promising to be the most cost-efficient medium, where we will let any high school student start creating an investment portfolio from starting with as small as a $100 investment!

We are reversing the MICRO-CREDITING system and will take MICRO-LOANS instead. Accumulating all those small inputs, we will amplify the output in return!

With our strategy of DIVERSIFICATION — we are ensuring the safest returnability with our MEAN-REVERSION investments. And help our young investors feel the growth.

Visit : InvesTriX.carrd.co to learn more !
how_its_made:
"E*TRADE" allows managing user account data, retrieving option chains, searching for exchanges, getting quotes, and managing orders.

"Marketstack" provides data on more than 170,000 tickers collected from 70 global exchanges, covering the Nasdaq and NYSE.

"Intrinio" unlocks real-time, delayed, intraday, historical prices, and options.
With Plaid API, developers can implement the fundamental function of connecting a bank account to your online investment app.

"Xignite" can help you with the market data feed functionality.

"Ally" delivers self-directed trading and managed-portfolio features.
